CKEditor 5 third-party notice
=============================

The file xerte-editor.bundle.js in this directory is produced from CKEditor 5
open-source packages published by CKSource. Those packages are licensed under
the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later (GPL-2.0+).

Xerte Online Toolkits as a whole is licensed under the Apache License, Version
2.0. Combining and distributing GPL-licensed CKEditor 5 with Apache-2.0 code
may have licensing implications for your deployment.

Organisations should:
  - Review GPL compatibility with their distribution model, or
  - Obtain a commercial CKEditor 5 license from CKSource if required.

Source for the bundle build lives under editor/ckeditor5-build/ (see package.json
for exact package versions and the GPL applies to those dependencies).

axe-core
========

This bundle also contains axe-core, an accessibility testing engine maintained
by Deque Systems, Inc. axe-core is licensed under the Mozilla Public License
2.0 and its license includes the Exhibit B "Incompatible With Secondary
Licenses" notice. Bundled third-party components also carry their own MIT or
ISC terms.

The exact axe-core version is recorded in
editor/ckeditor5-build/package-lock.json. Source, the MPL-2.0 license, and the
third-party license notices are available at:
https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core
